title: Noun Quantifiers and Countability
subtitle: many/much, few/little, a few/a little, a lot/lots/plenty, amount/number

ruleBlocks.text: Эта тема не про механическое запоминание списка, а про логику сочетаний. Сначала определи тип существительного (countable plural или uncountable), затем выбери семантику количества (много / мало / достаточно / недостаточно), и только после этого подставляй quantifier.

ruleBlocks.caption: Учебный алгоритм выбора quantifier
rows: a lot of / lots of / plenty of
a lot of ideas / a lot of work
глагол согласуется с noun после of
A lot of money is... / A lot of books are...

ruleBlocks.caption: Карта quantifiers (по учебной схеме)
rows: so very too many, a (large/great) number of, a great many
so very too much, a (large/great) amount of, a great deal of
plenty of, a lot of, lots of, a (large) quantity of
a few, several, a couple of

ruleBlocks.title: Базовая логика
lines: many, few, a few, several, a number of -> с countable plural
much, little, a little, a great deal of, an amount of -> с uncountable
a lot of / lots of / plenty of -> подходят и к countable, и к uncountable
число глагола после of зависит от noun после of

ruleBlocks.caption: Точечные правила из конспекта
rows: a lot/lots/plenty of + uncountable -> singular verb
There is plenty of time left. / A lot of money was spent.
a lot/lots/plenty of + plural noun -> plural verb
There are lots of apps available. / Plenty of stores stay open late.
most/half + noun -> число глагола по noun
Most of my salary is spent on food. / Half of the students don't like school.
нельзя; правильно much water, many people
